description.message: Find people who don’t follow you back on Duolingo and unfollow selected profiles after confirming.

accessSession.message: DuoFollow Connector uses the session cookie on www.duolingo.com to check the sign-in in your Chrome profile.

accessData.message: To compare follows, the extension retrieves profiles, avatars, follows and followers from Duolingo. The results appear in your browser on DuoFollow. An unfollow request is sent to Duolingo after you confirm it.

accessRecurring.message: While the DuoFollow site is open, it checks your sign-in status. When you return, it can repeat the last comparison for the username saved in your browser.

accessGrantedBack.message: Access granted. Return to the DuoFollow site.

accessChangeError.message: Could not change access. Open these settings again.
